title: OFFSITE SURGICAL REPROCESSING & STERILIZATION
agency: VETERANS AFFAIRS, DEPARTMENT OF > VETERANS AFFAIRS, DEPARTMENT OF > 262-NETWORK CONTRACT OFFICE 22 (36C262)
description:
This is a Sources Sought Notice only. This Sources Sought Notice is not a request for competitive quotes and no solicitation is available. All interested parties must respond to the Sources Sought Notice in writing. The purpose of this Sources Sought Notice is for market research to make appropriate acquisition decisions and to gain knowledge of potential qualified Service-Disabled Veteran Owned Small Businesses, Veteran Owned Small Businesses, 8(a), HubZone and other Small Businesses interested in and capable of providing the services described below. Responses to this notice must include the following: (a) company name (b) address (c) point of contact (d) phone and email (e) SAM UEI number (f) Business size standard, (g) an informal quote using the included price schedule, and (h) a capability statement that addresses the organizations qualifications and ability to perform the work described below. Supporting evidence must be furnished in sufficient detail to demonstrate the ability to fully comply with the requirement. The informal quote is for market research purposes only and will not form a binding agreement. 

  SEE THE ATTACHED SOURCES SOUGHT NOTICE  

 The purpose of this notice is to determine if there are interested contractors that are capable of providing Offsite Surgical Instrument Reprocessing and Sterilization Services for Long Beach Healthcare System located at 5901 E 7th St, Long Beach, CA 90822 for a period of one year. 

 The Draft Statement of Work included in this Sources Sought Notice is not final. No inquiries will be accepted at this time. Responses must be submitted via email only to Contract Specialist: Katharine Robert at katharine.robert@va.gov no later than 5:00 PM Pacific Time, November 30, 2026. 

  Intent to sole source : If no responses are received that indicate interested and capable vendors, the Government intends to issue a sole source award to Instrumentum California, LLC, who has previously provided these services to VA Long Beach Healthcare System.
